items.title: India's IT giants grapple with weak growth despite resilient deal momentum
items.description: Infosys reported results below expectations, impacting its stock performance negatively.  Other major IT companies also showed weak revenue growth in dollar terms.  AI-driven sales are gaining traction, though still on a small base.  Profitability varied across companies, with some margins contracting and others improving.  Stock valuations reflect uncertainty over future growth prospects and market conditions.

items.title: Hindustan Zinc Q1 Results: Net profit spikes 145% YoY to Rs 5,469 crore, revenue jumps 77%
items.description: Hindustan Zinc reported a Rs 5,469 crore net profit for Q1 FY27. This marks a substantial 145% year-on-year increase in earnings. The company's revenue from operations also saw a 77% rise. Total expenses for the quarter increased by over 33% year-on-year. These financial results cover the period ending June 30, 2026.

items.title: ACC Q1 results: Profit falls 61% YoY to Rs 147 crore as revenue, volumes decline
items.description: ACC reported a 61% YoY decline in June-quarter profit to Rs 147 crore as lower cement volumes, weaker operating margins and planned maintenance hit earnings. Revenue also fell, though the company saw improved trade sales, higher premium product mix and continued progress on capacity expansion and its merger with Ambuja Cements.

items.title: Tata Consumer Q1 Results: Net profit rises 28% YoY to Rs 427 crore, revenue up 12%
items.description: FMCG major Tata Consumer Products on Friday reported a consolidated net profit of Rs 427 crore for the April-June quarter of FY27, marking a nearly 28% year-on-year (YoY) rise from the Rs 334 crore net profit reported in the same period last year.

items.title: SBI Life Q1 results: Profit rises 22% YoY to Rs 720 crore  on strong premium growth
items.description: SBI Life Insurance reported a 22% YoY rise in June-quarter profit to Rs 720 crore, driven by robust growth in new business and renewal premiums. Gross written premium rose 20%, while value of new business climbed 29%. The insurer also reported higher embedded value, improved persistency and steady growth in assets under management.

items.title: Sterlite Tech Q1 Results: Profit skyrockets 870% YoY to Rs 197 crore as AI data centre orders lift earnings
items.description: Sterlite Technologies reported record quarterly revenue and profit, driven by strong AI-led demand for optical connectivity and data centre solutions. The company achieved a net debt-free balance sheet, secured a record order book and strengthened its AI-ready infrastructure portfolio.

items.title: ACC Q1 Results: Profit plunges 60% to Rs 147 crore on lower sales
items.description: ACC Ltd, part of the Adani Group, reported a staggering 60.8% decline in net profit for the June quarter. This drop in profitability can be attributed to a decline in sales volume, resulting in a 7.75% decrease in revenue compared to the previous year. While higher costs impacted earnings, the company noted that premium products gained market share.

items.title: REC Q1 Results: Net profit dips over 6% to Rs 4,193 crore
items.description: REC Ltd reported a year-on-year profit decline of six percent for the June quarter, primarily due to lower interest income affecting its consolidated net profit. Additionally, total income dropped compared to the previous year. The company announced an interim dividend of Rs 4.25 per share and declared a final dividend of Rs 1.55 per share for the past fiscal year.

items.title: Lodha Developers Q1 Results: Profit jumps 2-fold to Rs 1,373 crore
items.description: Lodha Developers reported a remarkable 100% increase in net profit for the first quarter, showcasing substantial growth in sales bookings, which rose by four percent to reach Rs 4,630 crore. Their total income has significantly outperformed the same quarter last year, marking the highest quarterly profit in the company's history. With confidence in sustaining a twenty percent CAGR, Lodha Developers is optimistic about long-term profit expansion.

items.title: V-Mart Retail Q1 Results: Profit surges 40% to Rs 47 crore
items.description: V-Mart Retail has reported an impressive 40.5% increase in net profit for the June quarter, reaching Rs 47.21 crore, up from Rs 33.60 crore. Revenue from operations surged by 23% to Rs 1,088.81 crore, while total expenses grew by 22% to Rs 1,031.94 crore. The company has also broadened its horizons by launching 15 new store outlets, reflecting its expansive growth strategy.

items.title: Bank of Baroda Q1 Results: Profit falls 72% to Rs 1,278 crore on one-off settlement hit
items.description: Bank of Baroda's June-quarter profit fell 72% due to a Rs 5,680 crore one-off settlement, despite strong loan growth and stable asset quality. Excluding the exceptional item, profit rose, supported by higher net interest income and healthy retail lending.

items.title: India's SBI Card posts higher quarterly profit on asset quality boost
items.description: SBI Cards announced an impressive profit surge attributed to lower provisions for bad loans. A remarkable rise in card spending highlighted robust consumer and corporate appetite, alongside a boost in total revenue propelled by increased transaction volumes across their card offerings. Furthermore, the company's asset quality has notably improved with a decline in gross non-performing assets and a significant yearly drop in loan loss provisions and credit costs.

items.title: Welspun Corp Q1 Results: Profit nearly triples to Rs 1,048 crore
items.description: It had reported a net profit of Rs 349.16 crore in the same period a year ago, the company said in an exchange filing.
